english.title: Fail to enter detail on the centre field of a recording sheet of tachograph recording equipment installed in a vehicle
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to complete the information required on the centre field of a recording sheet used in recording equipment installed in accordance with the Community Recording Equipment Regulation in a vehicle to which section 97 of the Transport Act 1968 applied, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)

Fixed penalty Ticket - fifty pounds
